craftysearch.screen.title: Storage
craftysearch.config.title: Crafty Search Settings
On: Missing ingredients are crafted from storage first (e.g. planks from logs). These recipes show a blue tint.
Off: Only recipes with every ingredient available are craftable.
Uses unlocked recipes only.
craftysearch.config.remember_search.tool: Keep the last search when the panel reopens.
craftysearch.config.only_takeable.toolti:
On: The panel only shows items you can take: within reach in client-only mode, and not the one Leave one keeps.
Off: The panel shows everything in range.
craftysearch.config.keep_one.tooltip:
On: Taking and crafting leave one of each item in every container, so put-away and copper golems keep sending it there.
Tools and other unstackable items are taken as usual.
Off: Containers can be emptied.
craftysearch.config.markers.tooltip:
Shows a marker with the count on screen over each highlighted container, through walls.
With shaders: only while a shader pack is on, since shaders hide the outlines.
Always: on every highlight.
Off: outlines only.
craftysearch.config.mouse.title: Mouse
craftysearch.config.scroll_direction.too: Sets which scroll direction pulls from storage; opposite direction stores items.
craftysearch.config.scroll_over_inventor:
On: Scroll over inventory items to move them to and from storage.
Off: Scrolling is left to vanilla or to Mouse Tweaks.
craftysearch.config.scroll_over_tiles.to:
On: Scroll over tiles to move items to and from storage.
Shift-scrolling scrolls grid.
Off: Scrolling scrolls grid.
craftysearch.config.shift_drag.tooltip: Shift-drag over inventory stacks (with the Store with button) to put each away, or over tiles to take a stack of each.
craftysearch.config.right_click.tooltip:
What right-clicking a tile does.
Open: opens the nearest container with it (in client-only mode only within reach).
Take one: one onto the cursor.
Show where: highlights its containers.
Take all: as much as fits in your inventory.
craftysearch.config.shift_right_click.to:
What shift-right-clicking a tile does.
Open: opens the nearest container with it (in client-only mode only within reach).
Take one: one into your inventory.
Show where: highlights its containers.
Take all: as much as fits in your inventory.
craftysearch.config.containers.title: Containers to Include
craftysearch.config.put_away.tooltip: Where items not currently in storage go: the nearest copper chest (useful for copper golem sorting), the nearest container with room, or the nearest empty container.
craftysearch.config.shift_click.tooltip: Choose which mouse button to use when shift clicking an inventory stack into storage. The opposite button will keep vanilla's shift-click.
craftysearch.config.client_only.title: Client-only Mode
craftysearch.config.client_only.note: Used on servers without Crafty Search
craftysearch.config.anti_cheat_safe.tool:
On: Normal speed, and Scan stacked carts, Extra block reach, Extra cart reach and Recheck used are off. Their own settings are kept.
Off: Each of them follows its own setting.
Warning: Containers are still opened in the background. No setting can promise an anti-cheat won't flag that.
craftysearch.config.speed.tooltip: Normal adds delay between actions to play it safe with anti-cheat. Fast skips the pauses: fine on vanilla servers, but anti-cheat may kick or ban you.
craftysearch.config.mute_sounds.tooltip: Silence containers the mod opens for you. Others still hear them.
craftysearch.config.hide_lids.tooltip: Keep chest and shulker box lids shut when the mod opens them. Others still see them open.
craftysearch.config.recheck_used.tooltip:
On: A container someone else used is read again in the background once it's closed and within reach.
Other players see it open. Warning: Strict anti-cheat may flag this.
Off: Its tiles are marked until you open it yourself.
craftysearch.config.scan_stacked_carts.t: Closing one cart of a stack reads the others within reach too, since some can't be opened by hand. Strict anti-cheat may flag this.
craftysearch.config.extra_block_reach.to:
Off: standard container reach (4.5 blocks).
On: maximum server limit (+1 block reach).
Warning: High risk of anti-cheat kicks or bans. Use with caution.
craftysearch.config.extra_cart_reach.too:
Off: Standard entity reach (3 blocks).
On: Extended reach (+2.5 blocks, near server limit).
Warning: High risk of anti-cheat kicks or bans. Use with caution.
craftysearch.config.shulker_contents.too:
On: Items inside shulker boxes count in the panel and get highlighted.
Taking an item that's only in a box takes the box.
Off: Shulker boxes count only as boxes.
